result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner remains visible over the already-loaded image on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now'. The rest of the layout looks consistent.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner (white circle with a partial green ring) is overlaid on the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, even though the image has fully rendered behind it. The loading indicator appears stuck, covers the main food image, and suggests the content is still loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide or remove the spinner once the image load event fires, and handle errors or timeouts so the indicator is always cleared. Check that the loading state is tied to the correct image element.
